def get_uniprot(uid):
    u = str(uid).strip().upper()
    if not re.match(r"^([OPQ][0-9][A-Z0-9]{3}[0-9]|[A-NR-Z][0-9]([A-Z][A-Z0-9]{2}[0-9]){1,2})(-\d+)?$", u):
        raise ValueError()
    buf = io.StringIO(urllib.request.urlopen(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{u}.fasta").read().decode())
    return u, "".join(buf.read().splitlines()[1:])

def plot_grid_with_letters(plot_funcs, sizes=3.5, ncols=2, panel_labels=True, main_title=None, wspace=0.5, hspace=0.5):
    n = len(plot_funcs)
    if isinstance(sizes, (int, float)):
        sizes = [sizes] * n
    nrows = math.ceil(n / ncols)
    full_sizes = sizes + [sizes[-1]] * (nrows * ncols - n)
    size_grid = [full_sizes[i*ncols:(i+1)*ncols] for i in range(nrows)]
    row_heights = [max(row) for row in size_grid]
    col_widths = [max(size_grid[r][c] for r in range(nrows)) for c in range(ncols)]
    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(sum(col_widths), sum(row_heights)))
    gs = fig.add_gridspec(nrows, ncols, width_ratios=col_widths, height_ratios=row_heights, wspace=wspace, hspace=hspace)
    if main_title:
        fig.suptitle(main_title, fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.95)
    axes = []
    for i, f in enumerate(plot_funcs):
        r, c = divmod(i, ncols)
        ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[r, c])
        f(ax=ax)
        if panel_labels and i < len(string.ascii_uppercase):
            ax.text(-0.12, 1.05, string.ascii_uppercase[i], transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', va='bottom', ha='right')
        axes.append(ax)
    fig.canvas.draw()
    fig_width, fig_height = fig.get_size_inches()
    dx = 0.2 / 25.4 / fig_width
    dy = 0.2 / 25.4 / fig_height
    for c in range(ncols - 1):
        for r in range(nrows):
            idx_l = r * ncols + c
            idx_r = r * ncols + c + 1
            if idx_l < len(axes) and idx_r < len(axes):
                pos_l = axes[idx_l].get_position()
                pos_r = axes[idx_r].get_position()
                x = (pos_l.x1 + pos_r.x0) / 2.0 - 0.004
                y_min = pos_l.y0 + dy
                y_max = pos_l.y1 - dy
                line = Line2D([x, x], [y_min, y_max], transform=fig.transFigure, color='gray', linewidth=0.5)
                fig.add_artist(line)
    for r in range(nrows - 1):
        for c in range(ncols):
            idx_top = r * ncols + c
            idx_bot = (r + 1) * ncols + c
            if idx_top < len(axes) and idx_bot < len(axes):
                pos_t = axes[idx_top].get_position()
                pos_b = axes[idx_bot].get_position()
                y = (pos_t.y0 + pos_b.y1) / 2.0
                x_min = pos_t.x0 + dx
                x_max = pos_t.x1 - dx
                line = Line2D([x_min, x_max], [y, y], transform=fig.transFigure, color='gray', linewidth=0.5)
                fig.add_artist(line)
    plt.show()
    return fig, axes

ZIKV Monoclonal Antibodies¶

We use A0A142I5B9 from UniProtKB as reference sequence to synchronize atomic coordinates

Monoclonal Antibody PDB ID Reference & Description
ZIKV-195 6MID Cryo-EM structure of the ZIKV virion complexed with ZIKV-195 Fab fragments. Long et al. (2019), PNAS. DOI.
EDE2 A11 5LCV Crystal structure of the Zika virus envelope protein in complex with the broadly neutralizing antibody EDE2 A11. Barba-Spaeth et al. (2016), Nature. DOI.
EDE1 C8 5LBS Crystal structure of the Zika virus envelope protein in complex with EDE1 C8, a broadly neutralizing antibody recognizing a conserved epitope shared between Zika and dengue viruses. Barba-Spaeth et al. (2016), Nature. DOI.
ZIKV-117 5KVE Structure of the Zika virus envelope protein in complex with ZIKV-117, a potent human monoclonal antibody targeting a quaternary epitope on the viral surface. RCSB PDB.
ZKA190 5Y0A Cryo-EM structure of Zika virus complexed with Fab of the potent human monoclonal antibody ZKA190 targeting an exposed epitope on DIII of the E protein. Wang et al. (2017), Cell. DOI.
ZV-67 5KVG Crystal structure of the Zika-specific mouse monoclonal antibody ZV-67 bound to ZIKV envelope domain III (lateral ridge epitope). Zhao et al. (2016), Cell. DOI.

#!/usr/bin/env python
###################################### RETRIEVAL, MAPPING and VISUALIZATION
SEED = 42
NICKNAME = "zikv"
OUT = Path(EXPORT_DIR)
HTML = OUT / "html"
HEAVY, LIGHT, ENVELOPE, ENVELOPE2, SCFV = "#28828b", "#94e9f3", "#b8483b", "#ec7767", "#b560b7"
CRIMSON, PEA, BASE = "#b8483b", "#acdf74", "#c7d0be"
PALETTES = {
    "6MID": {"E": ENVELOPE, "C": ENVELOPE2, "H": HEAVY, "L": LIGHT},
    "5LCV": {"A": ENVELOPE, "B": ENVELOPE2, "H": HEAVY, "L": LIGHT},
    "5LBS": {"A": ENVELOPE, "H": HEAVY, "L": LIGHT, "B": ENVELOPE, "I": HEAVY, "M": LIGHT},
    "5KVE": {"E": ENVELOPE, "L": SCFV},
    "5Y0A": {"A": ENVELOPE, "D": HEAVY, "E": LIGHT, "B": ENVELOPE, "F": HEAVY, "G": LIGHT, "C": ENVELOPE, "H": HEAVY, "L": LIGHT},
    "5KVG": {"E": ENVELOPE, "H": HEAVY, "L": LIGHT},
}
PDB_IDS = ["6MID", "5LCV", "5LBS", "5KVE", "5Y0A", "5KVG"]
PDB_ANGLES = [(-17, 60, -140), (-21, -6, 86), (101, -48, -104), (-81, -13, -70), (150, -30, -37), (-50, -30, -70)]
UPID = "A0A142I5B9"
CUTOFF = 1.2
HTML_WRAP = '<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"></head><body>{}</body></html>'

upseq = get_uniprot(UPID)
synced, rows = {}, []
for p in PDB_IDS:
    d = OUT / p
    pkl_path = d / f"{p}_{NICKNAME}.pkl"
    if pkl_path.exists():
        with open(pkl_path, "rb") as f:
            s = pickle.load(f)
    else:
        s = SyncedStructure.from_rcsb_id(p)
        for c in list(s.chain_ids):
            if c not in PALETTES[p]: s.remove_chain(c)
    sm = s.summary()
    rows.append(pd.DataFrame([sm] if isinstance(sm, dict) else sm).assign(pdb_id=p))
    synced[p] = s
sync_df = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)

matched, neighbours = {}, {}
for p, s in synced.items():
    try:
        mc = s.match_chains(upseq[1])
        ids = mc[mc["query_coverage_percent"] > 1]["auth_chain_id"].tolist()
        partners = s._chain_contact_partners(cutoff=CUTOFF)
        matched[p] = ids
        neighbours[p] = sorted({x for i in ids for x in partners.get(i, [])} - set(ids))
    except Exception:
        matched[p], neighbours[p] = [], []

views = []
for (p, s), ang in zip(synced.items(), PDB_ANGLES):
    for f in matched[p]:
        s.set_reference_sequence(chain_id=f, sequence=upseq[1], remap=True)
        s.set_external_ref(chain_id=f, external_ref=upseq[0])
        s.remap_chain(f)
    pal = {c: BASE for c in s.chain_ids} | {c: PEA for c in neighbours[p]} | {c: CRIMSON for c in matched[p]} | PALETTES[p]
    views.append(s.jupy_viz(title=f"Envelope ({p})", colors=pal, size=300, style="sphere", angles=ang))
panel = side_by_side(*views)

###################################### EXPORT
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
HTML.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
sync_df.to_csv(OUT / f"{NICKNAME}_summary.csv", index=False)
for (p, s), v in zip(synced.items(), views):
    d = OUT / p
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    s.export_alignment_stats(outdir=d)
    if matched[p]: s.export_residue_mapping(chain_ids=matched[p], outdir=d)
    pairs = [(a, b) for a in matched[p] for b in neighbours[p]]
    if pairs:
        tables = s.interface_all(pairs)
        tables["complex"].to_csv(d / f"{p}_{NICKNAME}_neighbour_contacts_complex.csv", index=False)
        tables["residues"].to_csv(d / f"{p}_{NICKNAME}_neighbour_contacts_residues.csv", index=False)
    (HTML / f"{p}_{NICKNAME}.html").write_text(HTML_WRAP.format(v.data), encoding="utf-8")
    with open(d / f"{p}_{NICKNAME}.pkl", "wb") as f: pickle.dump(s, f)
(HTML / f"{NICKNAME}_panel.html").write_text(HTML_WRAP.format(panel.data), encoding="utf-8")
panel

Interface between mABs and ZIKV Envelope protein¶

After collection and remapping we display contact interfaces between mABs: ZIKV-195, EDE2 A11, EDE1 C8, ZIKV-117, ZKA190, and ZV-67. We retrieved and synchronized Envelope protein residue coordinates to the polyprotein reference sequence from UniProtKB A0A142I5B9. PDB ids used in the research are 6MID, 5LCV, 5LBS, 5KVE, 5Y0A, 5KVG.

###################################### SEQUENCE EXTRACTION
interface_pairs_dict = {}
for p, s in synced.items():
    env = [c for c, col in PALETTES[p].items() if col in (ENVELOPE, ENVELOPE2)]
    ab = [c for c, col in PALETTES[p].items() if col in (HEAVY, LIGHT)]
    contacts = s.compute_contacts(cutoff=CUTOFF)
    for e in env:
        for a in ab:
            pair = contacts[((contacts.auth_chain_1 == e) & (contacts.auth_chain_2 == a))
                            | ((contacts.auth_chain_1 == a) & (contacts.auth_chain_2 == e))]
            key = f"{p}_{e}_{a}"
            interface_pairs_dict[key] = {}
            for c in (e, a):
                seq = s.get_sequence(c)
                mask = s.get_contact_sequence(c, contacts=pair)
                interface_pairs_dict[key][c] = {
                    "pdb_id": p, "env_chain": e, "ab_chain": a, "chain": c,
                    "seq": seq, "mask": mask,
                    "masked": "".join("X" if b == "0" else ch for ch, b in zip(seq, mask)),
                    "rev_masked": "".join("X" if b == "1" else ch for ch, b in zip(seq, mask)),
                }
pd.DataFrame([rec for pair in interface_pairs_dict.values() for rec in pair.values()]).to_csv(
    OUT / f"{NICKNAME}_interface_sequences.csv", index=False)
